description:
In the past, Han Kyul worked as the youngest barista at the famous cafe 'Atelier'.  
For some reason, he quit coffee and kept changed jobs for 3 years.  
Then one day, he was laid off, so he wandered unconsciously around.  
Back to none other than the cafe that had betray his trust?!  
But the cafe is nowhere to be seen... All that remains is the semi-basement warehouse and bunch of first-timers.   
"Do you want to do business here together?"
